name: ~Oume Tokkai~ Chikan Densha F-cup Mibouzuma Reiko
original_name: ～追雌特快～　痴漢電車Fカップ未亡妻　れいこ
source:
One day, Kudo's coworker suddenly passes away in an accident. When he takes part in his funeral, he meets his wife, Reiko. She is beautiful and he is soon attracted to her. With some evil idea in mind, he decides to take care of her....
